questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: Why must charset be declared early in <head>?
options: So the browser decodes the document correctly from the start
questions.correctAnswer: So the browser decodes the document correctly from the start
questions.explanation: Wrong charset = mojibake garbled text before the tag is seen.

questions.question: True or False: Translated text is often longer than English — layouts need flexible space.
Fill in the blank: dir="${dir}"  // right-to-left for Arabic/Hebrew
questions.explanation: dir controls text direction for bidirectional languages.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
